chunks: It was named al-Khayf because it is elevated above the valley, and everything that rises above the valley is called khayf.

key_terms.الْخَيْفُ: al-Khayf; the place being named and described
key_terms.خَيْفًا: khayf; a place elevated above a valley

ai.seo_question: Why is al-Khayf called al-Khayf in the context of hajj?
ai.summary: This report explains the naming of al-Khayf by linking the term to its topographical meaning. It states that a khayf is any place elevated above a valley, clarifying the linguistic reason behind the name in the context of hajj.
